theorem.justification: An explicit legal boundary family refutes the target-separation conjunct of the proposed four-mask experiment.
theorem.gap: Algebraic rank loss alone cannot create target separation when the primitive moment radius collapses every admissible loading mean to zero.
theorem.consumer: The negative resolution prevents the four-mask path from being used as an unconditional minimax or confidence-width lower experiment.

theorem.justification: A nonempty singular-margin shell may lie on a zero-target boundary, and the proposed deformation scale has only an upper bound.
theorem.gap: Shell nonemptiness supplies neither target-radius slack nor a deformation bounded below at the frontier scale.
theorem.consumer: Any future converse must impose and verify a quantitative nondegeneracy and same-shell interior condition.

proposed_statement_changes.reason: The equality of upper and lower loading-covariance radii is unnecessary. The landed effective-radius boundary result derives the covariance equality, zero loading means, and zero errors from the moment-radius equality and the covariance lower bound alone.

proposed_core_edits.proposed: \(\widehat\mu_c=\operatorname{clip}_{[-b_\lambda,b_\lambda]^T}\!\left\{\widehat U(\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat U_{S_c})^{-1}\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat\nu_c\right\}\), with the zero fallback specified in \(\operatorname{def:pca\text{-}estimator}\), and \[\mathcal R_N\leq\min\!\left\{1,4b_\lambda^2,\frac{C_0}{Ns_N^2}\right\},\qquad \mathcal W_{N,\alpha}\leq\min\!\left\{b_\lambda,C_\alpha\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\right\}.\] The observed-moment estimator and radius are the robust joint-moment constructions \(\widehat\theta\) and \(\widehat\rho_N\). These are unconditional upper guarantees on nonempty shells. The frozen class does not support a positive universal lower bound or necessity of \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\); a frontier-scale testing pair on a quantitatively nondegenerate subclass and a model-specific honest-width lower bound remain open.

sampling_model.design: Observational short panel with deterministic cohort-specific untreated masks and iid cross-sectional sampling.

prose_updates.tldr: Short panels with systematic missing outcomes require gluing cohort-specific covariance eigenspaces before missing untreated means become causal functionals. A deterministic smallest-two anchor convention maps every mask to the published rank-two count certificate of Pimentel--Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak, with Streinu--Theran pebble recognition and extraction as background. When the certificate passes, the observed local eigenspaces determine the global factor plane and an explicit complete-observed-law map recovers every untreated cohort-time mean. When it fails, the factor plane is generically nonunique, but the frozen primitive class does not imply causal-target nonidentification because an allowed tight-radius class has \(\mu=0\) throughout. The panel-specific corollary \(O_3\Rightarrow\) certificate acceptance is strict for masks \(123,145,256,346\). Covariance PCA gives the unconditional squared-risk upper bound \(\min\{1,4b_\lambda^2,C_0/(Ns_N^2)\}\), and robust profile-recentered moment inversion gives uniformly honest rectangles with upper half-width \(\min\{b_\lambda,C_\alpha\min(1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1})\}\). The universal same-shell deformation questions have negative answers on the zero-target boundary. Construction of a frontier-scale testing pair on a quantitatively nondegenerate frozen-model subclass, and a corresponding honest-width lower bound, remain open; \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) is sufficient but not necessary for consistency. The frozen stochastic class is not the full Lei--Ross class and does not itself assume strict exogeneity; its overlap with Lei--Ross is the no-covariate, no-fixed-effect, strictly exogenous, spherical-error subclass.

project_justification.gap: Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak provide the rank-two deterministic count criterion, Streinu and Theran provide sparse-hypergraph pebble machinery, and Lei and Ross provide \(O_3\)-sufficient identification and regular APM inference. What remains distinct here is the positive causal transport from observed cohort moments through local eigenspaces and the relation kernel to an explicit complete-observed-law functional. Under the frozen primitive class, certificate failure proves factor-plane ambiguity but not different causal-target values; shell nonemptiness alone also fails to supply a target-separating lower experiment. No model-specific minimax or honest-width lower frontier is claimed.
project_justification.niche: The paper studies fixed-\(T\) causal recovery under deterministic cohort masks, separating generic factor-plane certification from causal-target identification. It combines the published certificate with an explicit observed-law mean functional, the strict panel-specific \(O_3\) containment witness, a radius-adaptive covariance-PCA upper risk bound, and a radius-adaptive uniformly honest moment-inversion upper width near a singular relation margin.
project_justification.fill: The paper takes the published count and pebble results as inputs, proves that certificate acceptance yields complete-observed-law identification of every untreated cohort-time mean, and proves that certificate failure yields only generic factor-plane nonuniqueness without further primitive slack. It records strict \(O_3\) containment and develops the upper bounds \(\min\{1,4b_\lambda^2,C_0/(Ns_N^2)\}\) for risk and \(\min\{b_\lambda,C_\alpha\min(1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1})\}\) for honest-rectangle half-width. The universal same-shell deformation claims are refuted by a legal zero-target boundary class; lower frontiers require a separately verified nondegenerate restriction.

prose_updates.related_work: Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak provide the rank-two deterministic count criterion for generic subspace identification and matrix completion; that rank/count reduction is cited background rather than a novelty claim. Streinu and Theran supply sparse-hypergraph pebble recognition, extraction, component algorithms, and complexity. Király, Theran, and Tomioka identify generic completion through Jacobian closure and determinantal matroids. The distinct causal step here recovers cohort conditional eigenspaces from the complete observed law and proves that certificate acceptance yields an explicit functional for every missing untreated mean; certificate failure is interpreted only as generic factor-plane nonuniqueness. Lei and Ross provide the closest econometric geometry through their \(O_3\) overlap-merging condition and APM estimator. The frozen stochastic class is not the full Lei--Ross class and is not merely its strict-exogeneity intersection: it assumes cohort conditional mean-zero errors, loading--error covariance orthogonality, spherical conditional error covariance, and the stated moment and eigengap restrictions. Its overlap with Lei--Ross is the no-covariate, no-fixed-effect, strictly exogenous, spherical-error subclass. The use of \(O_3\) here is geometric: its acceptance implies canonical certificate acceptance, while masks \(123,145,256,346\) are certificate-accepted and \(O_3\)-rejected. Srivastava and Pimentel-Alarcón establish reciprocal-singular-value projection perturbation, which supports upper analysis but does not furnish a legal target-separating experiment in this frozen model. Yan and Wainwright study growing staggered-block matrices, Zhu studies weak-factor honesty costs, and Andrews and Cheng develop identification-robust inference; none supplies the nondegenerate same-shell testing pair needed for lower risk and width frontiers here. Liu, Wang, and Xu provide a concrete consumer through the \(\operatorname{fect}\) counterfactual-imputation workflow.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: Certificate failure makes the generic factor plane nonunique, but the frozen primitive class permits a tight moment radius that forces every cohort loading mean, and hence every causal target coordinate, to zero. Therefore certificate failure alone does not imply causal-target nonidentification, shell nonemptiness does not imply a target-separating deformation, and \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) is sufficient but not necessary for consistency. The covariance-PCA guarantee is the unconditional upper bound \(\min\{1,4b_\lambda^2,C_0/(Ns_N^2)\}\); robust profile inversion gives the upper half-width \(\min\{b_\lambda,C_\alpha\min(1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1})\}\). A frontier-scale testing pair on a quantitatively nondegenerate subclass and a model-specific honest-width lower bound remain open. The profile inversion is an exact optimization over a compact primitive closure; numerical certification is outside the theorem.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The smallest-two anchor convention is deterministic, and the rank-two count criterion and pebble algorithms are published background. The paper claims the distinct positive causal transport: certificate acceptance makes every untreated cohort-time mean an explicit functional of the complete observed law. On certificate failure it claims generic nonuniqueness of the factor plane only, not observed-law-equivalent causal targets with different missing means. The panel-specific corollary \(O_3\Rightarrow\) certificate acceptance and its strict four-mask witness remain. Covariance PCA and the total profile-recentered robust moment inversion provide radius-adaptive upper guarantees on nonempty singular-margin shells. The universal early-kill and shell-deformation questions are answered negatively by a legal zero-target boundary class, so no minimax lower frontier, honest-width lower frontier, or necessity of \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) is claimed under the frozen class. The frozen stochastic class itself does not impose strict exogeneity and is not identical to the Lei--Ross class; only the no-covariate, no-fixed-effect, strictly exogenous, spherical-error subclass is shared, and \(O_3\) is used only for geometry.

statement_notes.justification: The explicit slope path passes the algebraic rank-loss test, but the allowed moment boundary collapses the causal target and therefore refutes the required target-separation conjunct.
statement_notes.gap: A relation singularity does not by itself provide primitive slack for a complete-law lower experiment.
statement_notes.consumer: The result blocks use of the four-mask path as an unconditional minimax or confidence-width converse.

statement_notes.justification: The zero-target boundary supplies an explicit nonempty-shell counterexample, and the one-sided deformation scale is independently too weak for a frontier lower bound.
statement_notes.gap: A valid converse needs both quantitative target nondegeneracy and a deformation bounded below at the asserted scale.
statement_notes.consumer: Future lower-bound work must state and verify an interior-slack subclass rather than infer it from shell nonemptiness.

statement_notes.justification: The sharp moment boundary and the loading-covariance lower bound force equality throughout the moment chain; no equality between the covariance upper and lower radii is needed.

statement_notes.consumer: The corrected lemma supplies the model-wide zero-target certificate used by the negative deformation and nonnecessity results.

statement_notes.justification: The common moment radius and covariance trace lower bound yield the exact feasible loading-mean radius and its equality case.
